sentences.en: The Melbourne police raided the bookstore for violating censorship laws.
sentences.zh: 墨尔本警方因违反审查法而突袭了那家书店。

sentences.en: There was a drug raid on my house this morning.
sentences.zh: 今天早上有人对我家进行了毒品搜查。

sentences.en: They shot down two enemy planes during the raid.
sentences.zh: 他们在袭击中击落了两架敌机。
